calendars.name: Circulaire MESRS n°28/2026 - Calendrier de l'année universitaire 2026-2027
calendars.summary: Official circular dated 1 July 2026 (scanned PDF, Arabic). Rentrée Tue 1 Sep 2026 for prep institutes, engineering schools, ENAU, faculties of medicine/dentistry/pharmacy, ENMV Sidi Thabet and ISETs; Sat 12 Sep 2026 for all others. Min. 28 weeks of teaching. Holidays: 15 Oct 2026 Évacuation; 17 Dec 2026 Révolution; winter break 12 Dec (after classes)-27 Dec 2026; 1 Jan 2027; spring break 19 Mar (after classes)-4 Apr 2027; 20 Mar 2027 Indépendance; 9 Apr 2027 Martyrs; 1 May 2027 Travail; Aïd el-Fitr, Aïd el-Adha and Ras el-Am el-Hijri (1 day) to be fixed later by the Mufti. No exam periods in the circular (set by each institution).
